caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure in a dark-colored, likely black, gown adorned with light blue, cream, and pink accents. The dress features a wide off-the-shoulder neckline with a scalloped and ruffled trim, and the sleeves are elbow-length with a layered, flared design that includes trims of light blue and pink lace. The bodice is fitted and cinched at the waist with a rosette decoration in the center. The skirt is full, with multiple, zigzagged horizontal bands of varying widths in black, trimmed with blue and pink lace, extending to the ankles. The figure's feet are in pink ballet-style shoes with crisscross laces. The woman has pale skin and dark, parted hair styled in tight curls, and she wears a three-strand necklace with circular gold pendants. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, rear view of the figure that shows a large bow at the back of the waist and additional lace and ruffle details on the dress. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing includes a signature "P. Romano" at the bottom right.
title: Doll - "Minerva Pratt"
